job.title: Senior SAP Commerce and Service Cloud Lead

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience building, extending, and supporting SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong technical background in Java, Spring, microservices, and CCv2, with proven ownership in designing OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP data pipelines, and database optimization. Experienced in leading query refactoring, conducting code reviews, mentoring developers, and bridging technical and business requirements.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Commerce and Service Cloud Lead
cover_en.hook: With more than five years of hands-on enterprise experience developing and extending SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for global corporations like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical ownership across modern commerce architectures. I am eager to contribute my expertise in Java, Spring, and CCv2 to lead robust commerce solutions for your team.

bullets.label: Commerce Architecture & Leadership
bullets.text: Served in a senior development role at Rockwell Automation, providing technical guidance to junior developers, conducting rigorous code reviews, and designing core platform features across product, catalog, and pricing structures on Hybris 2211.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud v2 & Headless APIs
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) at Shell, while developing and exposing headless OCC RESTful web services for PWA and external storefront consumers.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Designed and optimized high-throughput PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using DataHub, Hotfolders, and Profisee, resolving critical data bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and commerce channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Bridged business stakeholders and engineering teams by translating business requirements into precise user stories, functional specifications, and scalable technical designs.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required), and am currently serving my notice period with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss my experience with you.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my five-plus years of SAP Commerce Cloud delivery to a team driving enterprise-scale e-commerce initiatives. Having delivered complex CCv2 architectures, headless OCC APIs, and ERP integrations for Shell and Rockwell Automation, I appreciate environments that value high standards of software engineering, robust system design, and reliable cross-system integrations.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), Java/Spring, and integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to take on technical ownership and drive high-performance commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I saw your opening for a Senior SAP Commerce Lead. I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (2105/2211, CCv2, Java/Spring) experience from Rockwell Automation & Shell, with technical mentorship & integration ownership. Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit.
tailoring.offer: In my first months, I can immediately take ownership of your CCv2 platform stability, code quality, and OCC API designs, drawing on my production experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I will streamline cross-system data flows across your commerce backend and lead performance refactoring to ensure fast, reliable transactions.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior SAP Commerce and Service Cloud Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am a backend developer with over five years of professional experience extending enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

I am eager to contribute to your team by providing strong technical ownership across CCv2, Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs. My background includes mentoring developers, executing CCv2 deployments, and designing stable integrations with enterprise systems like SAP ERP and PIM.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit and am serving my notice period with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
